notes.title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon Patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
"Bigger" patch:

-Confusion's Violent Flee skill renamed to Violent Thrash
-Tranquilizer typo fixed
-Updated Comfy Pillow's description
-Fixed Quick Hands description
-Updated Chef Frog's dialogue
-Stitches status curse now stays for a battle instead of whole run like originally intended
-Changed Character: Merchant's description
-Merchant Jr's shop text changes for Chapter 1 and Chapter 3
-Characters remain in their hit animation for 3 frames longer
